newsHighlights.title: Ningbo through world mayors' eyes: Building bridges between cities
newsHighlights.summary: At the 2026 Global Mayors Dialogue in Ningbo, mayors from New Zealand, Lebanon and Mauritius shared their impressions of the city and reflected on the importance of friendly exchanges and mutual learning.
newsHighlights.translation: 在2026宁波全球市长对话会上，来自新西兰、黎巴嫩和毛里求斯的市长们分享了他们对这座城市的印象，并就友好交流与互学互鉴的重要性畅谈感想。

newsHighlights.title: Wuzhen Summit: Understanding the deeper meaning of China's open source
newsHighlights.summary: At China's first open-source-themed ecosystem experience center at the 2026 World Internet Conference Wuzhen Summit, the idea of open source becomes strikingly clear as a spirit of sharing and cooperation.
newsHighlights.translation: 在2026年世界互联网大会乌镇峰会的中国首个开源主题生态体验中心，开源的含义变得清晰可见——它是一种分享与合作的精神。

newsHighlights.title: 9th China International Import Expo opens in Shanghai
newsHighlights.summary: The ninth edition of the China International Import Expo, the world's first national-level exhibition dedicated to imports, opened on Thursday in Shanghai.
newsHighlights.translation: 全球首个以进口为主题的国家级展会——第九届中国国际进口博览会于周四在上海开幕。

newsHighlights.title: US companies' presence at CIIE expands
newsHighlights.summary: More US companies are taking part in the China International Import Expo this year, expanding their presence and deepening business dialogue with Chinese partners.
newsHighlights.translation: 今年更多美国企业参与中国国际进口博览会，扩大参展规模，并深化与中国伙伴的商务对话。

quote.quote: The single biggest problem in communication is the illusion that it has taken place.
quote.author: George Bernard Shaw
quote.translation: 沟通中最大的问题，是人们误以为沟通已经发生了。
quote.explanation: 职场中最常见的陷阱，是说完就以为对方听懂了。真正有效的沟通需要确认、反馈与持续的对话，正如本次宁波市长对话会所体现的——交流不是形式，而是彼此理解的过程。

vocabulary.translation: 2026全球市长对话会为城市领导者提供了面对面交谈的机会。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自标题 Ningbo through world mayors' eyes: Building bridges between cities 中的 Global Mayors Dialogue。

vocabulary.translation: 市长们就城市之间互学互鉴的重要性交换了看法。

vocabulary.example: The import expo is a major initiative for opening the Chinese market to the world.
vocabulary.translation: 进口博览会是中国向世界开放市场的一项重大倡议。

pattern.pattern: Rather than simply + V-ing ..., 主语 + 过去式 ... (与其只是……，不如/而是……)
pattern.example: Rather than simply presenting data, the mayors shared their personal impressions and reflected on the value of mutual learning.
pattern.translation: 与其只是罗列数据，市长们不如分享个人感想，并思考互学互鉴的价值。
pattern.usage: 该句型用于对比两种做法，突出后者更可取，非常适合在工作汇报、邮件或演讲中表达自己的沟通理念。注意 Rather than 后接动名词或不加 to 的不定式，主句谓语与句子主语保持一致。

grammar.title: 现在分词短语作结果状语（V-ing as an adverbial of result）
grammar.explanation: 当主句动作自然导致某种结果时，可用现在分词短语放在句末作结果状语，表示‘从而……、结果……’。与不定式作结果状语（常表示出乎意料）不同，现在分词表示顺理成章的结果。它逻辑上的主语必须是主句的主语或整个主句内容。
examples: The ninth China International Import Expo opened in Shanghai, drawing more US companies than ever.
Mayors from New Zealand, Lebanon and Mauritius gathered in Ningbo, building bridges between cities and deepening mutual understanding.

pronunciation.tips: 重音在第一个音节 /ˈdaɪ/，/aɪ/ 是双元音，要从 /a/ 滑向 /ɪ/，口型由大到小；中间音节弱读为 /ə/，几乎一带而过；结尾的 -gue 只发 /ɡ/，不发音的字母 u 不要读出。整体节奏是‘重—弱—轻’。
examples: The Global Mayors Dialogue focused on friendly exchanges between cities.
Good dialogue in the workplace starts with careful listening.

reading.title: Dialogue as a Bridge: Lessons in Communication from Mayors and Business Leaders
reading.content:
The 2026 Global Mayors Dialogue in Ningbo brought together city leaders from New Zealand, Lebanon and Mauritius. Rather than simply presenting data, they shared personal impressions and reflected on the value of mutual learning. Their conversations offer a useful lesson for the modern workplace: real communication begins with listening.

Meanwhile, the ninth China International Import Expo opened in Shanghai, drawing more US companies than ever. Behind every contract lie hours of dialogue, negotiation and trust-building.

Three habits stand out. First, speak clearly and avoid jargon. Second, show genuine interest in the other person's perspective. Third, follow up with actions, because trust grows from consistent behaviour.

As the Wuzhen Summit reminded participants, openness is not a weakness but a strength. In any office, an open ear and an honest reply can build bridges that last far longer than any single deal.
reading.translation:
2026宁波全球市长对话会汇聚了来自新西兰、黎巴嫩和毛里求斯的城市领导人。他们没有仅仅罗列数据，而是分享了个人感想，思考互学互鉴的价值。他们的交流给现代职场带来了一个有用的启示：真正的沟通始于倾听。

与此同时，第九届中国国际进口博览会在上海开幕，吸引了比以往更多的美国企业。每一份合同的背后，都是数小时的对话、谈判与信任建立。

有三个习惯尤为突出：第一，表达清晰，避免行话；第二，真诚关注对方的视角；第三，用行动跟进，因为信任来自始终如一的行为。

正如乌镇峰会提醒与会者的那样，开放不是软肋，而是力量。在任何办公室里，一双倾听的耳朵和一次真诚的回应，所能架起的桥梁，远比任何一单生意更长久。
reading.sourceNote: 本文基于 2026 年 11 月 5 日至 6 日 China Daily 关于宁波全球市长对话会、第九届中国国际进口博览会开幕、美国企业扩大参展，以及世界互联网大会乌镇峰会开源主题生态体验中心的报道改写，用于英语学习，非原文转载。
